Native Windows and Linux (Steam Deck / SteamOS) build of T.R.A.G. - Tactical Rescue Assault Group (PlayStation, NTSC-U, SLUS-00813), statically recompiled; graphics re-rendered with OpenGL at higher resolution.

**No game files included** - you need your own disc image (`.chd`, or the `.cue` + its `.bin`).

1. Download `TRAG-@TAG@-win64.zip` (Windows) or `trag-@TAG@-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` (Linux / Steam Deck) below and unpack it.
2. First run only: put your disc image next to `trag.exe` / `trag` (or in the `game` folder) and run it - or drag the image onto the exe. It is imported once into `assets.dat` and checked to be an exact copy; after that the disc image can be deleted. Nothing else to install.

F1 / Esc (Start+Select on a controller): settings, including key and button rebinding. Hold Tab: fast-forward. Saves go to `memcard1.mcd` (a standard PS1 memory card image, usable in emulators).

Port extras: up to 8x internal resolution, 16:9 widescreen, precise (wobble-free) geometry, texture filtering, xBR upscaling of the pre-rendered backgrounds, true colour or original dithering, scanline/CRT filter, high-quality audio resampling, fast CD loading, DualShock vibration.

Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Sunsoft or Sony.
